test_mode: direct production MCP; conversational activation and refusal not tested

result.instructions: RenewalRadar surfaces upcoming renewal risk, under-use, overlap, and negotiation priorities. Verify contract terms before action.

tools.name: assess_renewal
tools.description: Assess a software, vendor, service, lease, or other recurring contract renewal using spend, usage, overlap, price increase, notice period, auto-renewal, and criticality. Returns timing risk and review priority, not legal termination advice.
tools.title: assess renewal

positive.prompt:
This auto-renews in 20 days and requires 30 days notice. Annual spend is $12k and usage is 30%.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"annualized_spend": 12000, "auto_renews": true, "criticality": 50, "days_to_renewal": 20, "notice_period_days": 30, "overlap_score": 0, "utilization_percent": 30}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
